title: Career Roadmap · Community Health Worker
summary: A Community Health Worker connects people with healthcare services through health education, prevention programmes, outreach, follow-up and referral support, especially in underserved communities.

about.label: Education
about.text: Role-specific community-health training; ANM, GNM or other recognised qualifications may be required for particular clinical duties.

blocks.label: Recommended stream
blocks.text: Any stream may suit some community outreach roles; Science with Biology is useful for healthcare progression.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Biology, health education, English, social science and communication.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: Depends on the specific training programme and employer.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Nutrition, sanitation, maternal-child health, immunisation awareness and public health.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Listening, communication, community engagement, recordkeeping and teamwork.

items.text: Community Health Worker training → Community outreach, health education and referral-support roles, subject to programme and employer requirements.
ANM diploma → Nursing-related maternal-child and community-health roles, subject to registration and scope of practice.
GNM diploma → General nursing pathway with clinical responsibilities after required registration.
B.Sc. Public Health / related degree → Broader public-health programme, outreach coordination and further-study opportunities.
B.Sc. Nursing → Degree-level nursing pathway, subject to admission eligibility and registration.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: A short community-health course does not automatically authorise nursing, diagnosis, prescribing or other regulated clinical procedures.
Select training based on the intended role: community outreach, public-health programme support or registered nursing.
Government / public options to investigate

items.text: National Health Mission (NHM) — check state community-health workforce and training notifications.
Andhra Pradesh health department / state NHM — verify current outreach recruitment and training.
Government nursing schools in Andhra Pradesh — investigate recognised ANM / GNM programmes.
JIPMER, Puducherry — explore public-health and allied-health education options.
AIIMS institutions — investigate relevant public-health or nursing programmes.

blocks.text: Private / academic options to investigate

items.text: Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) — check current public-health training offerings.
Manipal Academy of Higher Education — investigate public-health programmes.
Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham — check current public-health and health-sciences offerings.
Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research — investigate public-health education.
Recognised NGOs and community-health organisations — verify structured training, supervision and certificate value.

blocks.text: These are research leads, not a ranking or confirmation of a specific Community Health Worker qualification at every institution. Verify current course availability, recognition and eligibility.

Eligibility depends on the scheme, course, income, domicile and category. A community volunteer role may not qualify for the same support as a formal diploma or degree. Check National Scholarship Portal.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Health communication, hygiene, nutrition and community needs assessment.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Field skills
blocks.text: Outreach, beneficiary records, referral processes and health-campaign support.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Supervised practice
blocks.text: Maternal-child health awareness, immunisation follow-up and home-visit procedures relevant to the assigned role.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Progression
blocks.text: Programme reporting, digital data entry, community mobilisation and additional recognised training.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Community health-needs survey • Immunisation follow-up tracker • Nutrition-awareness session • Referral completion dashboard.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic qualifications, English proficiency where required, programme prerequisites, funding evidence and student-visa requirements. Verify current official admission information.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Community Health Worker, Health Outreach Worker, Health Promotion Assistant, Public Health Project Assistant.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Community health services, public-health agencies, nonprofit organisations and health-research programmes.

Requirements vary significantly. Some countries and employers require local certification, language proficiency, background checks or additional healthcare training. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.

Community Health Trainee ↓ Community Health Worker ↓ Experienced Outreach Worker ↓ Senior Field Worker / Team Facilitator ↓ Public Health Programme Coordinator ↓ Programme Manager / Public Health Specialist
